item.title: Self-Hosted Animal Shelter & Rescue Management: ASM3 vs Shelter Manager vs PetAdoption
item.description: Animal shelters and rescue organizations manage complex operations spanning animal intake, medical treatment tracking, foster home coordination, adoption processing, volunteer scheduling, and donor relationship management — all while operating under the constant pressure of limited kennel space and the ethical imperative to minimize euthanasia rates. Despite the mission-critical nature of this data, a surprising number of shelters still track animals on whiteboards, Excel spreadsheets, or aging desktop software installed on a single computer in the front office.
